shown_card_text.title: EP4: weekly limits, two meters
shown_card_text.what: Claude and Codex weekly meters fill across a week, pause at the top and reset, with no real usage numbers. It is one of the reusable core animations for EP4, in the locked look.
shown_card_text.why: You asked for more core animations we can reuse in EP4.
shown_card_text.question: What should happen to this animation?
shown_card_text.recommendation: Use it under any weekly limit line in EP4.
context: Eight seconds, wide format for the episode, with no sound so it sits under your voice.
